## 1. Donation receipt visual/source contract (CG-07 donation owner + CG-19 protected document owner)

- Landscape, thin rounded red/pink outer border. CareGanga round multicolour mission logo plus blue/green wordmark and tagline across top. Center address block on pale cream and receipt-number/date panel on right.
- Distinct full-width amount-in-figures and amount-in-words bar with currency mark. A **donor details** panel left and temporary receipt / payment purpose / payment details panels right.
- Legal organisation registration panel: registered corporate identifiers and current actual **80G approval status**, not an assumed tax-deduction entitlement. Payment mode and authorized signatory section; bottom legal disclosure, contextual help/contact and approved website QR.
- Use real CG-07 immutable donation source, payment provider reference or verified cash/UPI, donor-consented minimal data and CG-19 authentic issued template/version. Receipt issue is not automatic 80G approval or a second CG-09 cash posting. A real payment state must come from original CG-07/CG-09 authority, not the PDF.
- Phone, email, address, CIN/PAN/TAN, domain and authorisation/stamp **must come from approved current Foundation configuration**. The old PDFs contain sample-specific legal strings and differing domain/registration representations; do not hard-code them.
- Enforce authorized personal-data download, snapshot/QR source verification, immutable receipt number, reprint identity and reasoned cancellation/correction without silent edits. Template may be configured per Foundation, keeping one default V1. Do not invent a multi-template engine.

## 2. Donor certificate visual/source contract (CG-07 source + CG-19)

- Landscape decorative green/blue/gold frame with original logo and non-profit designation, *To Whom It May Concern* ribbon, donor name, amount, acknowledgment sentence, issued location/date, certificate number, validity dates and named verified signatory roles.
